verdict.rationale: Clerk ships official SDK libraries. Evidence includes the official clerk/javascript GitHub repo, a first-party Next.js integration, and an MCP server plus CLI built to feed AI agents up-to-date Clerk SDK snippets. A hands-on community comment praises the Next.js integration, while another reports painful transitive dependencies and hard-to-debug obfuscated library code. Missing for 10: an explicit enumeration of supported SDK languages/frameworks and SDK reference docs in the evidence, plus independent corroboration that resolves the reported dependency and debuggability pain.
